title: feat: useNavigationSync hook + NavigationSyncEffect — auto-sync navigation tree on Page/Dashboard CRUD
body:
Page/Dashboard create, delete, and rename operations don't propagate to the App's `navigation[]`, forcing manual maintenance of the navigation tree.

### Changes

- **`apps/console/src/hooks/useNavigationSync.ts`** — New hook exposing six per-app methods (`syncPageCreated`, `syncDashboardCreated`, `syncPageDeleted`, `syncDashboardDeleted`, `syncPageRenamed`, `syncDashboardRenamed`) that mutate `AppSchema.navigation` immutably, persist via `client.meta.saveItem`, refresh metadata, and show a sonner toast with **Undo**
- **All-apps convenience methods** — `syncPageCreatedAllApps`, `syncDashboardCreatedAllApps`, `syncPageDeletedAllApps`, `syncDashboardDeletedAllApps`, `syncPageRenamedAllApps`, `syncDashboardRenamedAllApps` iterate all apps without requiring explicit `appName`
- **`NavigationSyncEffect` component** — Headless component mounted in `AppContent` that monitors `pages` and `dashboards` metadata arrays, auto-detects additions/removals via diffing, and syncs navigation across ALL apps automatically. Includes effect cancellation on unmount and version-based race condition prevention.
- **Pure utility functions** exported for testability:
  - `addNavigationItem` / `removeNavigationItems` / `renameNavigationItems` — immutable tree operations with recursive group traversal
  - `navigationEqual` — structural equality with fast-path for same reference
- **`apps/console/src/App.tsx`** — Mounts `<NavigationSyncEffect />` inside `AppContent` to activate automatic navigation sync
- **`apps/console/src/__tests__/useNavigationSync.test.tsx`** — 38 tests covering utilities, hook behavior, all-apps methods, NavigationSyncEffect auto-detection, error handling, undo flow, and edge cases (missing app, no-op delete/rename, undefined navigation)
- **`apps/console/src/__tests__/console-load-performance.test.tsx`** — Bumped eager import threshold from 20 → 21
- **`ROADMAP.md`** — Added entries under P1.7 for Navigation Sync Service, auto-detection, and all-apps API

### Usage

```tsx
// Per-app sync (explicit appName)
const { syncPageCreated, syncPageDeleted } = useNavigationSync();
await syncPageCreated('crm', 'settings', 'Settings');
await syncPageDeleted('crm', 'settings');

// All-apps sync (no appName needed)
const { syncPageCreatedAllApps, syncPageDeletedAllApps } = useNavigationSync();
await syncPageCreatedAllApps('settings', 'Settings');
await syncPageDeletedAllApps('settings');
```

Each call persists the updated app schema and shows a toast with an undo action that restores the previous navigation state.

### Automatic sync

`NavigationSyncEffect` is mounted in `AppContent` and watches metadata for page/dashboard additions and removals. When changes are detected, it automatically syncs navigation across all apps — no manual calls needed for create/delete operations. Rename detection requires explicit calls to `syncPageRenamed` / `syncDashboardRenamed` since renames cannot be distinguished from delete+create via metadata diffing alone.

> <issue_title>Navigation结构自动同步服务：Page/Dashboard CRUD联动导航树</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 背景
> 
> 当前Page和Dashboard的新增、编辑、删除操作并不会自动同步到App的导航结构（Navigation tree）。NavigationDesigner组件是纯受控，Navigation数据只在AppCreationWizard和EditAppPage中被持久化。导致开发者需要手动维护导航结构，非常容易遗漏、增加出错概率。
> 
> ## 需求细节
> 
> ### 功能目标
> - 新建Page后自动将对应导航项（type: 'page', pageName）添加到App的navigation[]
> - 新建Dashboard后自动将对应导航项（type: 'dashboard', dashboardName）添加到App的navigation[]
> - 删除Page/Dashboard时递归移除navigation[]中所有引用此页面/仪表盘的项
> - 重命名Page/Dashboard时同步更新navigation[]中的引用
> - 操作完成后通过Toast通知用户导航结构已更新，同时支持undo撤销
> - 不影响NavigationDesigner手动编辑navigation的能力
> 
> ### 技术实现建议
> 
> - 新增`useNavigationSync` hook或`NavigationSyncService`，监听Page/Dashboard CRUD事件，操作App schema的navigation字段。
> - 事件建议在MetadataProvider统一分发，避免在各个DesignPage内写imperative代码，提高解耦性。
> - 更新navigation后调用`client.meta.saveItem('app', appName, updatedSchema)`，并触发metadata.refresh。
> - 删除时递归处理所有子group。
> - 支持用户undo撤销（可用Toast提示+撤销按钮方案）。
> 
> ### Acceptance Criteria
> - [ ] 新建Page后，导航结构自动添加对应项
> - [ ] 新建Dashboard后，导航结构自动添加对应项
> - [ ] 删除Page/Dashboard后，导航结构自动移除所有相关项
> - [ ] 重命名Page/Dashboard后，导航结构自动同步所有引用
> - [ ] 操作完成有Toast通知，支持撤销
> - [ ] NavigationDesigner原有手动编辑功能不受影响
> 
> ### 技术选型需评估
> - 事件分发机制、导航结构的数据一致性、错误/冲突处理等。
